prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup targeted actual-source layout correction. Edit the provided full DooKnow large-file fragment page. Preserve owner shell, exact controls, title/role, loaded-only fragment semantics and all action guards. Correct the following SOURCE relationships only:
1. Source NoteOutline is a HORIZONTAL WRAPPING NAV, not a left sidebar. Remove the extra vertical “章节” column/divider. Above the fragment range/editor, display one compact horizontal row: small “章节”, outlined buttons “记录与回顾” and “整理方法”, then a thin full-width bottom divider. The fragment editor and range status must fill the FULL available main width below this row.
2. The source main note header is ONE compact row: sidebar-toggle icon, back icon, forward icon, breadcrumb “笔记本 > 00-Inbox > 隔离示例长文” at left, existing 收藏 star / 分享 / 更多 at right. Remove the duplicate large h1 title row; the title appears only in breadcrumb. No ordinary full-document save/history/undo/formatting/mode controls.
3. This coherent synthetic fragment is four loaded lines with a VERY LONG FOURTH LINE continuing horizontally offscreen, so update read-only range to “第 1–4 行 · 0–131072 字节 · 已保存”. Maintain max128KiB loaded-fragment limit, file has further content. Render line-number gutter exactly1,2,3,4 and first visible content exactly:

Everything else unchanged. Flat white/light-gray/blue UI, readable typography, complete desktop page, no extra features or captions.
